answer: Require every agent to stake a bond that is slashed if its attestations are later judged dishonest, like a timber company posting a deposit before it may log a canyon watershed: creating thousands of fake identities means funding thousands of bonds, and a shared atlas of past behaviour lets peers check whether an identity has ever earned trust before accepting its votes. The cost scales with each Sybil while honest agents reuse one stake, so flooding the network becomes expensive and traceable.
